_description: Personal/family document archive. 10 shallow categories, YYYY-MM-DD naming.
_source: Tuck 10-folder system + Paperarchive + Locument best practices (2026)

categories.name: Finance
categories.description: Financial documents: bank statements, credit cards, investments, loans, receipts, invoices, bills, budgets, payroll, pension

children.name: Banking
children.description: Bank and credit-card statements, transaction histories, account summaries, IBAN confirmations

children.name: Taxes
children.description: Tax returns, assessments, Steuerbescheid, Einkommensteuer, W2, T4, 1099, EÜR, Anlage, Finanzamt correspondence

children.name: Receipts
children.description: Purchase receipts, invoices, expense confirmations, order confirmations, Rechnungen

children.name: Investments
children.description: Brokerage statements, portfolio reports, dividend notices, DeGiro, trade confirmations

categories.name: Legal
categories.description: Contracts, agreements, NDAs, leases, rental agreements, wills, power of attorney, notarial deeds, court documents, legal notices

children.name: Contracts
children.description: Signed contracts, rental agreements, Mietvertrag, employment contracts, service agreements

children.name: Government
children.description: Government letters, official notices, Bescheid, Vollstreckung, Pfändung, court orders, municipal correspondence

categories.name: Health
categories.description: Medical records, prescriptions, doctor letters, lab results, insurance claims, Krankenkasse, dental, vision, fitness

categories.name: Identity
categories.description: Passports, ID cards, driver's license, birth certificates, marriage certificates, residence permits, visas, Aufenthaltstitel, Meldebescheinigung

categories.name: Employment
categories.description: Offer letters, employment contracts, pay stubs, Lohnsteuerbescheinigung, performance reviews, references, Arbeitszeugnis, termination letters

categories.name: Education
categories.description: Degrees, diplomas, transcripts, professional certifications, course certificates, training records, Zeugnis, continuing education

categories.name: Insurance
categories.description: Insurance policies, claims, coverage documents: health (TK, AOK), auto (KFZ), home (Hausrat), liability (Haftpflicht), life

categories.name: Property
categories.description: Lease, mortgage, Grundbuch, property deeds, home repairs, warranties, utilities, Nebenkostenabrechnung, Betriebskosten, vehicle registration, KFZ-Brief

categories.name: Travel
categories.description: Flight tickets, boarding passes, hotel bookings, itineraries, train tickets, car rental, visa applications, travel insurance

categories.name: Archives
categories.description: Compressed archives and installers: zip, tar, rar, 7z, dmg, iso, exe, msi, pkg
